dcterms:description: 300-W is currently the most widely used dataset for face alignment. It was created from four datasets including the AFW, LFPW, HELEN, and IBUG dataset, each face image is annotated with 68 landmarks.
dcterms:title: 300-W

dcterms:description: The COFW dataset focuses on occlusion in nature. The training set consists of 1345 images, the testing set consists of 507 faces with a wide range of occlusion patterns, and each face is annotated with 29 landmarks.
dcterms:title: COFW

dcterms:description: WFLW is considered the most challenging dataset. It contains 10000 faces (7500 for training and 2500 for testing) with 98 fully manually annotated landmarks and corresponding facial bounding boxes. It includes rich attribute annotations, such as occlusion, pose, make-up, blur, and illumination attribute information.
dcterms:title: WFLW
